description:
Use this when you need an auditable Sri Lanka working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this is a combined official holiday-class calendar, not a universal private-employer closure rule. Public, bank and mercantile classifications remain in each event kind; the March 18, March 25 and April 1 fuel-conservation entries apply to government offices only and the schedule was cancelled effective April 8. Essential services, schools, private employers, sector agreements, local arrangements and later unlisted notices are not inferred. The additional day after the National Vesak Festival is not invented beyond the published May 2 calendar entry.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range.
Example user requests: Count Sri Lanka working days around Poya holiday. | Count Sri Lanka working days around Temporary government-office Wednesday.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-04-13","end_date":"2026-04-14","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/sri-lanka-public-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/sri-lanka-public-working-days-between.md
name: count_lk_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Sri Lanka 2026 public, bank, mercantile and full-moon Poya holiday calendar, plus dated temporary government-office closures

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

substitute_day_policy.description: published_official_dates_only; no next-day or employer-lieu inference; later Gazette or official circular overrides

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Sri Lanka Working Days
